summary: Two ready-to-apply test/fixture patches, five native cases, a bounded eight-case/engine runner and exact matrix delta. All original leaves remain partial pending native execution and broader residual requirements.

validation.assertions: Three fixture mirrors and one native spec typecheck using virtual logical source paths and current built public declarations; zero diagnostics. Static compiler evidence only, no supported-runtime behavioral or browser claim.
Both proposed patches apply cleanly to inspected current working files; no patch applied.
Static full-title grep selects exactly 8 cases x 3 configured engines; missing origin and user port3000 rejected; no browser/server execution.

retainedFailure.reason: Checker initially resolved node types from repo root instead of configured workspace directory. Corrected checker getCurrentDirectory; unchanged proposed artifacts pass. Not a production failure.
